header.title: Table
header.description: Data table built on TanStack Table v9. It includes column sorting, row selection, column groups, expandable rows, sticky columns, horizontal scroll and virtualization for large lists. Columns are defined with createTableColumnHelper.

playground.title: Playground
playground.description: Adjust the props to see the table and the code. With `rows` set to 0 the empty message appears.

base.title: Basic usage
base.description: Define columns with `createTableColumnHelper` and memoize them with `useMemo`. `cell` customizes the content, like a `Badge` or an amount formatted with `Intl`. `getRowId` gives each row a stable id.

caption.title: Table caption
caption.description: `caption` names the table for screen readers; it's visually hidden by default. `showCaption` displays it, `extra` adds content beside it and `captionSide="bottom"` moves it below, like a note.

texts.caption: Latest issued invoices, sorted by date.

sorting.title: Sorting
sorting.description: Click a header to sort: descending, ascending and unsorted. Shift + click adds another column. `sorting` and `onSortingChange` control the state.

selection.title: Row selection
selection.description: `enableRowSelection` adds a checkbox column. `isRowSelectable` locks some rows: here, paid invoices. `rowSelection` is a `{ [id]: true }` map.

rowClick.title: Select on row click
rowClick.description: `selectOnRowClick` selects when clicking anywhere on the row, and the row can be focused with Tab and activated with Enter or Space. With `enableMultiRowSelection={false}` only one can be chosen.

actions.title: Actions column
actions.description: `helper.display()` creates a column that reads no data, ideal for buttons. Give each icon button an `aria-label` that includes the row: "Delete INV-0001". Try deleting a row.

scroll.title: Horizontal scroll and sticky columns
scroll.description: `meta.minWidth` keeps columns from being squeezed, so narrow screens get horizontal scroll. `meta.sticky: "start"` pins the Invoice column and `"end"` pins the payment method.

groups.title: Column groups
groups.description: `helper.group()` nests columns under a shared header and adds rows to the header. Country names come from `Intl.DisplayNames` for the current language.

expand.title: Expandable rows
expand.description: `renderExpanded` shows a panel below the row, which can hold another table. `isRowExpandable` hides the button on rows without details and `defaultExpanded` opens some at start.

stickyHeader.title: Sticky header
stickyHeader.description: `stickyHeader` with `maxHeight` keeps the header visible while the body scrolls. The scroll area can be focused with Tab to move it with the keyboard.

virtualized.title: Virtualization
virtualized.description: `virtualized` renders only the visible rows, for lists with thousands of rows. It needs a height: `maxHeight`, or 400px by default. There are 1000 rows here and only a few dozen in the DOM.

empty.title: No results
empty.description: With no rows, the table shows `emptyMessage` spanning every column. Clear the search to see the data.

pagination.title: With pagination
pagination.description: `footer` adds content below the table, like a `Pagination`. The table doesn't paginate by itself: pass only the current page's rows.

sizes.title: Sizes
sizes.description: `size` accepts `sm`, `md` (default) and `lg`. It changes cell padding and typography.

header.title: Table API
header.description: API reference for the React Table: props, column meta, helpers, CSS classes, variables, tokens and exported types.

demos.title: Demos
demos.description: For examples and usage details, visit the component demo page.

import.title: Import
import.description: Import it from the main entry or from its subpath. `SortingState`, `RowSelectionState` and `ExpandedState` are exported too.

columns.title: Defining columns
columns.description: `createTableColumnHelper<TData>()` returns the TanStack Table helper already typed with Gem's features: `accessor` for data columns, `group` to group them and `display` for columns without data. `meta` adds alignment, minimum width and sticky columns.

inheritance.title: Inheritance
inheritance.body: Table accepts <div> attributes except children. They go to the root container, not the <table>. Use classNames to style inner parts.

a11y.title: Accessibility
a11y.caption: Always pass caption: it's the table's name for screen readers, even when it isn't visible.
a11y.headers: Headers are <th scope="col">, and groups are scope="colgroup".
a11y.sorting: Sortable columns have a <button> in the header and aria-sort on the <th>. The sort icon is decorative.
a11y.labels: selectAllLabel, selectRowLabel, expandRowLabel, collapseRowLabel and emptyMessage default to English. Pass them translated.
a11y.rowLabels: selectRowLabel and expandRowLabel are the same on every row. If your table has many rows, put the identifying value in the first column so screen readers announce it next to the checkbox.
a11y.rowClick: With selectOnRowClick each row gets tabIndex="0" and activates with Enter or Space. Clicks on buttons, links and inputs inside the row don't select it.
a11y.expand: The expand button has aria-expanded. The collapsed panel has aria-hidden and inert.
a11y.scroller: With maxHeight, the scroll area gets tabIndex="0" so it can be moved with the keyboard.
a11y.virtualized: With virtualized, the header and body live in two separate <table> elements and only visible rows are in the DOM. Screen readers lose the link between cells and headers. Use it only when the row count justifies it, and prefer pagination.

cssClasses.title: CSS classes
cssClasses.description: Classes you can use to override styles.

rules.size: Size: `--sm`, `--md` or `--lg`. Changes cell padding and typography.
rules.bordered: Applied with `bordered`. Without a border, `--borderless` is applied.
rules.scroller: Scroll area. Receives `classNames.scroller`. `--y` with `maxHeight`; `--clip-start` and `--clip-end` show a shadow on sticky columns.
rules.caption: `<caption>`. Receives `classNames.caption`. Modifiers: `--top`, `--bottom`, `--hidden`.
rules.sort: Sort icon. Receives `classNames.sort`. `--asc` or `--desc` when sorted.
rules.footer: Footer below the scroll area. Receives `classNames.footer`.

cssVariables.title: CSS variables
cssVariables.description: Table has almost no variables of its own: use classes or `classNames` to change colors and spacing.

items.--gem-table-max-height: Maximum height of the scroll area. Set by `maxHeight`.

items.--gem-color-fg-muted: Caption, sort icons and empty message.
items.--gem-color-primary-{500|600}: Hover, selected row and active sort icon.
items.--gem-shadow-focus: Focus ring on buttons, rows and the scroll area.

types.title: Exported types
types.description: Available from @gem-org/gem-system to type your own wrappers.

props.title: Props
props.description: The table also accepts `<div>` attributes (see Inheritance). Every state (sorting, selection, expansion) can be controlled or left uncontrolled.

data.title: Data and content
data.description: Rows, columns and content around the table.

layout.title: Appearance and scroll
layout.description: Density, borders, sticky header and virtualization.

meta.title: Column meta
meta.description: Options inside `meta` on each column definition.

items.getRowId: Unique id for each row. Defaults to the index, which changes when sorting or filtering.
items.caption: Table name. Visually hidden unless `showCaption` or `extra` is set.
items.extra: Content at the end of the caption row, like actions.
items.footer: Content below the scroll area, like pagination.
items.emptyMessage: Text when there are no rows.
items.enableMultiSort: Allows sorting by several columns with Shift + click.
items.isRowSelectable: Only rows that return `true` can be selected.
items.selectOnRowClick: Selects when clicking the row, outside its controls.
items.selectAllLabel: Accessible name of the header checkbox.
items.selectRowLabel: Accessible name of each row checkbox.
items.renderExpanded: Content of the panel below an expanded row.
items.isRowExpandable: Only rows that return `true` show the button.
items.onExpandedChange: Called when a row expands or collapses.
items.expandRowLabel: Accessible name of the expand button.
items.collapseRowLabel: Accessible name of the collapse button.
items.stickyHeader: Keeps the header visible on vertical scroll.
items.maxHeight: Maximum height of the scroll area. A number is read as pixels.
items.virtualized: Renders only visible rows. Needs a height.
items.estimateRowHeight: Estimated row height for virtualization. The default depends on `size`.
items.virtualOverscan: Extra rows rendered above and below the visible ones.
items.minWidth: Minimum column width. A number is read as pixels.
items.sticky: Pins the column on horizontal scroll: `true` or `"start"` on the left, `"end"` on the right.
items.createTableColumnHelper: Creates the typed column helper for your data.
items.gemTableFeatures: TanStack Table features used by Gem: sorting, selection and expansion.
